src/camera.js.name: Camera sheet
src/camera.js.description: Opens the live camera or a photo, lets the child fit the side in the square, shows the colors it reads, and fills the grid.

src/main.js.name: Start-up
src/main.js.description: Starts the app: applies the saved language, restores progress, builds the cube, and runs the two-tap Start over button.

src/ui.js.name: Screens and flat turns
src/ui.js.description: Draws every screen, shows each turn flat with its sliding layer, arrow and After picture, spins the 3D cube on the start and check screens, saves progress on the phone, and loads the 3x3 solver when it is needed.
